title: Flux 3 Extend Video
description: FLUX 3 is Black Forest Labs' frontier video model. This endpoint continues an existing clip beyond its final frame, generating additional footage that stays consistent with the original motion and scene.

pricing.text: Your request will be charged at 0.41 $ per second of generated video at 720p, and 0.53 $ per second at 1080p.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt describing how the video continues from the source clip's final frames.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the generated video. `auto` lets the model choose.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: Duration of the generated video in seconds. `auto` lets the model choose.

inputs.name: generate_audio
inputs.tooltip: Whether to generate audio for the video.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated video. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: URL of the input video. MP4, under 50 MB and under 15 seconds.
